content: Rule-engine test-runner UI patterns (GoRules/IBM ODM/OpenRules/Corticon/DecisionRules): common multi-panel layout — test events/input panel, node/rule trace center, results/variables right. Essential surfaces: fired-rules list with step-through, working-memory/variable inspector (values before/after evaluation), inference trace ordered by fire sequence, per-node/per-rule timing (microsecond-level), decision-table row match highlighting (matched vs evaluated vs violated), expected-vs-received diff highlighting, coverage per row/rule. Advanced: breakpoints on rules, step into/over, agenda view of scheduled activations, CSV trace export, test suites with Pass/Fail/Error states and execution-time column, save-adhoc-run-as-test, programmatic test API. Distinguishes great from minimal: live working-memory deltas + step-through + per-rule timing + diff highlighting.
